title: Initial pre-algebras as a generalization of dendriform algebras
summary: We continue the study of \emph{initial dialgebras} defined in~\cite{DMS2026}. For a binary operad $\Var$ we define the class of initial pre-$\Var$-algebras and the corresponding operad $\pre\Var^{\I}$ in such a way that \[ (\di\Var^{\I})^{!}=(\pre(\Var^{!}))^{\I} \] in the case when $\Var $ is quadratic. We propose an intuitive algorithm for finding the defining relations of the operad $\pre\Var^{\I}$ in the case when $\Var$ is a binary quadratic operad.
